title: UI风格#199 - Sci-Fi Scanner (科幻扫描)
description: 创建第199种UI风格：科幻扫描风格 - 全息扫描、蓝色发光、科幻界面。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGQ.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sci-Fi Scanner style When color palette Then features scanner blue, cyan glow, dark space
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#00BFFF (扫描蓝), #00FFFF (青色), #0A0A1A (深空), #1A1A3A (暗蓝)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sci-Fi Scanner style When typography Then uses sci-fi: Orbitron, Exo 2, Rajdhani
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Orbitron (科幻), Exo 2 (未来), Rajdhani (技术)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sci-Fi Scanner style When layout Then scanner lines, holographic displays, data readouts
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：扫描线、全息显示、数据读数

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sci-Fi Scanner style When UI elements Then scan animation, holographic flicker, data pulse
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：扫描动画、全息闪烁、数据脉冲

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sci-Fi Scanner UI When functional Then includes scan chat, sensor agents, scan stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：扫描聊天、传感器代理、扫描统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sci-Fi Scanner UI When copy Then uses scanner: 'Scan', 'Detect', 'Analyze', 'Pulse'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SCAN. DETECT. ANALYZE.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'SCAN'、'DEPLOY'→'ACTIVATE'
